SELECT json_build_object(
  'projects', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.*) FROM (
    SELECT p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase,
      p.handover_date IS NOT NULL AS has_handover,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM briefings WHERE project_id=p.id AND status='approved') AS briefing_approved,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM design_options WHERE project_id=p.id AND is_selected=true) AS design_selected,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id=p.id AND breakdown IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(breakdown) > 0) AS cost_breakdown_ok,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contracts WHERE project_id=p.id AND contract_type='encargo_profesional' AND status='signed') AS encargo_signed,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contracts WHERE project_id=p.id AND contract_type='acta_recepcion_provisional' AND status='signed') AS acta_recepcion,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM safety_plans WHERE project_id=p.id AND exec_status='confirmed') AS safety_confirmed,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM permit_applications WHERE project_id=p.id AND status='approved')::int AS permits_approved,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consent_records cr WHERE cr.client_id=p.client_id AND cr.revoked_at IS NULL) AS gdpr_consent,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE project_id=p.id AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','cancelled') AND severity IN ('high','critical'))::int AS aftercare_urgent,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings WHERE project_id=p.id AND (severity='critical' OR affects_safety=true) AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed'))::int AS pathology_critical,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM qc_checks WHERE project_id=p.id AND status='blocked')::int AS qc_blocked
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.current_phase NOT IN ('completed','archived') AND p.status='active'
    ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 60
  ) t), '[]'::json)
) AS report;
